title: Story bed: ominous (underscore)
description: Bass drones through the loop seam, a muted frame-drum heartbeat with a skin click, low piano octaves with the tritone, a soft bowed-vibes drone and dissonances, the motif four times slower on piano at D4/D5. Underscore: the motif statements and lead lines are muted.
usage: The UNDERSCORE: the same bed with the motif and lead lines muted, for use under narration. Loops seamlessly. -26 LUFS-S with a voice pocket at 1.25-2 kHz for the narration; duck it with scripts/audio/duck.py (the band-split duck, its default). All four story beds share 75 BPM, so they can be switched on a bar line (every 3.2 s).
instruments: VCSL frame drum, bass drum, cymbal swell
selfReview: The ominous story bed without the slow piano motif, for use under speech. See bed-story-ominous.
